boundary: The lemma uses only the dimension n of the parameter space, not the structure of E47. Injectivity into the moduli space modulo all diffeomorphisms is conditional on the imported fact.
conditional_on: The plane-wave equivalence group F(u) -> s a^2 F(a u + b) exhausts isometries between the Brinkmann plane waves g_q.

evidence.B: E0 conditional on the imported fact

lemma.A_vacuum: Ric = -(1/2)(H_xx + H_yy) du^2 for any H(u,x,y); H = F(u)(x^2 - y^2) is harmonic, so every g_q is Ricci-flat.
lemma.B_injectivity: n odd, N even, N >= n+3: the equivalence group element relating two anchored profiles is (s,a,b) = (1,1,0), so q = q'.
lemma.C_parity_obstruction: n even: (s,a,b) = (1,-1,0) relates q and q' with q'_a = (-1)^a q_a; the map is not injective.
lemma.e47_instance: n = 47, N = 78 (used in e47_intrinsic_spacetime_unmarked.py); N = 50 would also do.
lemma.family: g_q = -2 du dv + dx^2 + dy^2 + F_q(u)(x^2 - y^2) du^2, F_q = u^N + u^n + sum_{a<n} q_a u^a
